build_sentencepiece_trainer_spec: build a TrainerSpec protobuf message to configure sentencepiece model training with vocab size and model type
create_model_proto: create a ModelProto protobuf message containing sentence pieces, trainer spec, and normalizer spec
build_normalizer_spec: build a NormalizerSpec protobuf message to configure text normalization with charsmap and rules

review_sentence_piece_type: review ModelProto.SentencePiece.Type enum with NORMAL, UNKNOWN, CONTROL, USER_DEFINED, BYTE, UNUSED values
